description: The acceptance test a Guild work order's poster or a contract milestone's client named before the run, as the registry recorded it (with the piece of work it settles, so a verifier or a buyer checking offline holds the exact bytes the run was bound to), and the verdict recorded under it once a party handed in the receipt chain: hashes and the verdict, never circuits, counts or results. An order or a milestone with a test settles only on a passing verdict. Public; 404 where no test was named. Listed where this registry's QUANTUM_WORKLOADS_MODE is shadow or on; under off it answers the switch's sentence.

rail.description: guild_work_order (a Guild work order) or contract_milestone (a contracts v2 milestone)

ref.description: The order id (gwo_...) or the contract id (ctr_...)

seq.description: The milestone's number, for a contract milestone only
